criteria.description: Versioned Parquet manifest schema with all idea.md columns; fail-closed validation; URI scheme + path-traversal guards; JSONL debugging-only; restricted reports referenced not embedded; migration + introspection commands; shape-bucket hints are non-authoritative

criteria.description: Patient-disjoint splitting by default; site-disjoint and temporal holdouts; studies/tiles/slides/cases kept together via grouping keys; duplicate content hashes detected across splits; auditable split report with seed + grouping keys; refuse-to-train gate unless a ResearchOverride is recorded
criteria.evidence: medfm/data/splits.py; tests/phase_03/test_splits.py (14 tests incl. deliberately-corrupted patient/group/content leakage and override gating)

criteria.description: NIfTI, MHA, NumPy-volume, and PNG/JPEG readers; DICOM series discovery + physical-position sorting; orientation/spacing/frame-of-reference validation; CT rescale slope/intercept + MONOCHROME1 correction; multiframe/scout/mixed/unsupported-pixel detection; UID hashing; actionable errors

criteria.description: Common slide-reader contract (dimensions, levels, MPP, thumbnails, regions, tiles); OpenSlide + TiffSlide backends; cuCIM behind a capability check; pre-extracted tile + embedding-store readers; validated pyramid-level coordinate conversion; corrupt regions recoverable at tile scope

criteria.description: medfm data fingerprint reports patient/study/sample counts, modality/shape/spacing/intensity/label/missing/site/vendor/duplicate stats, text length + WSI MPP/magnification + segmentation volumes, split-leakage results, deterministic fingerprint hash, and bounded shape-bucket recommendations; machine-readable report

criteria.description: Preprocessing/visual-embedding/tokenization cache interfaces; keys include source hash, reader version, preprocessing hash, model id/revision, layer, dtype; atomic writes; corrupt-entry detection + quarantine; LRU eviction metadata; accelerator-neutral CPU tensors; rank-safe coordinator-only / per-rank partitions

criteria.evidence: medfm/data/samplers.py; tests/phase_03/test_samplers.py (exact coverage across ranks/epochs, group integrity, padding sentinels, pre-collective resolution)
